title: Capacity Canvas: interleaved cycle planning and hot-path scope triage
creator: Priya Shah
description: Create a lightweight, reproducible 'Capacity Canvas' artifact and decision flow that PMs + Eng leads can use every cycle to: 1) surface interleaved initiatives and hot-path work, 2) map available FTE and contractor capacity to outcomes, 3) provide clear scope-cut rules tied to latency/cost/SLAs, and 4) formalize reserve lanes for emergent reliability or customer escalations. Deliverables: Capacity Canvas template (Confluence), a spreadsheet staffing simulator, a one-page playbook for scope-triage signals, and a checklist for cycle kickoff and mid-cycle re-eval.
outcomes: Repeatable Canvas template used at cycle kickoff by >3 product lines
Staffing simulator demonstrates 3+ scenario outputs (best/likely/worst) and recommends scope delta
Triage rules reduce mid-cycle surprise scope cuts by making decision criteria explicit
Documented handoff to Eng leads for rolling over reserve lanes into backlog or burn-down
updates: 2025-08-02 - Priya Shah: Kickoff with Eng leadership. Agreed scope: Canvas + simulator + one-pager. Assigned Liam as owner and Sofia Kim as design reviewer.
2025-08-05 - Liam O'Connor: Draft canvas v0 uploaded to Confluence. Focused columns: initiative, owner, expected latency/cost delta, optional/critical flags, cross-team dependencies.
2025-08-07 - Sofia Kim: Design feedback - simplify columns for faster triage; added visual guardrail for 'reserve lanes' and color-coded critical path.
2025-08-10 - Marcus Lee (Eng): Provided capacity estimates by squad; highlighted two hot-path initiatives with potential infra SLO risk.

2025-08-12 - Liam O'Connor: Built staffing simulator (spreadsheet) with baseline, +20% contractor, and -15% attrition scenarios. Simulator suggests trimming ~10%-18% of non-critical scope under worst-case.

2025-08-14 - Priya Shah: PM review meeting. Decided on triage rule: if projected latency delta > 15% OR cost/unit > 12% with no customer ROI, mark as candidate for deferred scope. Agreed to reserve one full squad as emergent lane for next cycle.
2025-08-16 - Liam O'Connor: Draft one-pager playbook created. Included decision checklist, escalation path to Head of Product, and example language for stakeholder communication.
2025-08-18 - Priya Shah: Shared draft with GTM and Support for feedback. Action: collect feedback by 2025-08-22 and finalize before cycle planning session on 2025-08-25.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas template accepted by 2 product lines and 2 eng leads
Simulator can ingest team-level FTE and output recommended scope delta
Playbook contains explicit triage signal thresholds and communication templates
All artifacts published in Confluence and linked from cycle kickoff doc
risks: Capacity estimates are optimistic and may understate cross-team ramp time
Design changes late in cycle could invalidate simulator outputs
Stakeholder misalignment on what qualifies as 'critical' may stall decisions
next_steps: Run tabletop scenario with Eng leads on 2025-08-24
Finalize Canvas and Playbook before cycle kickoff (2025-08-25)
Instrument simple tracker in Console to capture mid-cycle reserve lane utilization
